entries.title: Psalms 51:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David, when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your loving-kindness; according to the multitude of Your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

entries.title: Psalms 51:2
segments: Wash me completely from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

entries.title: Psalms 51:3
segments: For I confess my transgressions; and my sin [is] ever before me.

entries.title: Psalms 51:4
segments: Against You, You only, have I sinned, and done evil in Your sight; that You might be justified when You speak, [and] be clear when You judge.

entries.title: Psalms 51:5
segments: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity, and in sin did my mother conceive me.

entries.title: Psalms 51:6
segments: Behold, You desire truth in the inward parts; and in the hidden [part] You shall make me to know wisdom.

entries.title: Psalms 51:7
segments: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean; wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

entries.title: Psalms 51:8
segments: Make me to hear joy and gladness; [that] the bones [which] You have broken may rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 51:9
segments: Hide Your face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.

entries.title: Psalms 51:10
segments: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.

entries.title: Psalms 51:11
segments: Cast me not away from Your presence, and take not Your Holy Spirit from me.

entries.title: Psalms 51:12
segments: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and uphold me [with] a willing spirit.

entries.title: Psalms 51:13
segments: [Then] I will teach transgressors Your ways; and sinners shall be converted to You.

entries.title: Psalms 51:14
segments: Deliver me from the guilt of shedding blood, O God, O God of my salvation, [and] my tongue shall sing aloud of Your righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 51:15
segments: O LORD, open my lips, and my mouth shall show forth Your praise.

entries.title: Psalms 51:16
segments: For You do not desire sacrifice; or else I would give [it]; You do not delight in burnt offering.

entries.title: Psalms 51:17
segments: The sacrifices of God [are] a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, You will not despise.

entries.title: Psalms 51:18
segments: Do good in Your good pleasure to Zion; build the walls of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Psalms 51:19
segments: Then shall You be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering; then they shall offer bulls on Your altar.
